title: Write the full name of the member who spent money for water, veggie tray an
question:
Write the full name of the member who spent money for water, veggie tray and supplies and include the cost of it.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: full name refers to first_name, last name; spent money for refers expense description; expense_description = 'Water, Veggie tray, supplies'

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    m.XCL_035 || ' ' || m.XCL_036 AS full_name,
    e.XCL_020 AS cost
FROM 
    expense e
JOIN 
    member m ON e.XCL_022 = m.XCL_034
WHERE 
    e.XCL_021 IN ('water', 'veggie tray', 'supplies')
